title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 017
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute train and attachment variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded train vehicle with three window panels above a flat track line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a side view train with a rounded nose and visible windows.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the front facing trains when the long side view silhouette matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected train shown from the side with three windows and a rail line.

items.depicts_observation: Front train vehicle with a display bar two lights and outward track lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a head on train with a display panel and two lower lights.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the striped or slanted windshield trains when the display bar is the main cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot centers a front train face with a top display bar and two round lower lights.

items.depicts_observation: Front train vehicle with two horizontal bars and one round light
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a head on train marked by two horizontal bands across the body.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the display bar or windshield variants when the twin stripes matter visually.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs by showing two horizontal body stripes and one centered round light.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded front train vehicle with a slanted window panel and two bottom lights
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a head on train whose main cue is the slanted windshield panel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the striped or display bar trains when the windshield shape matters most.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the most rounded front train with a slanted windshield opening.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted paper clip with two long parallel loops
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the most familiar tilted paper clip shape for attachments.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the hooked or upright clips when the diagonal double loop should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the classic diagonal paper clip with two long nested loops.
